comparison.objective: Install a rack rail versus infer engine top dead centre using two piston-stop contacts.
comparison.physical_skill: Compliant latching and fastening versus bidirectional crank rotation, contact detection, stop removal and angular midpoint positioning.
comparison.success_condition: Persistent four-point rail engagement versus crank within 2 degrees of TDC with the stop tray-placed and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Contact-based inference and angle setting are not tested by the rail task. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
